scenarios.title: Wastewater & biogas digital twin
scenarios.description: Operate treatment, sludge, biogas and power branches from one connected plant, with instrument taps and PLC-controlled valves. All views share editable illustrative equations.

experiments.title: Stop the inlet lift pump
experiments.expected: Water transfer through the lift pump stops; downstream buffers and sludge/gas supply respond through the same model.
experiments.limitation: No hydraulic residence time or treatment quality is predicted.

experiments.title: Close the sludge valve
experiments.expected: Sludge feed is isolated while the stored gas pathway can continue briefly.
experiments.limitation: Inventory and time constants are arbitrary teaching indices.

experiments.title: Inject a digester leak
experiments.expected: The digester shows a leak/fault and loses availability. Inspect its retained inventory and downstream flows, then repair it.
experiments.limitation: Leak severity and fault response are fictional editable rules, not containment design.

experiments.title: Overload the electrical branch
experiments.expected: The connected generator cannot satisfy the requested load; observe supply warnings and stress as the shared clock advances.
experiments.limitation: No electrical protection, voltage, frequency or real load-flow calculation.

experiments.title: Break the biogas generator
experiments.expected: The electrical load loses its connected supply. The flare remains a separate branch of the gas process.
experiments.limitation: No automatic safety logic or real emergency sequence is implied.

experiments.title: Isolate CHP fuel
experiments.expected: The CHP fuel flow and connected electrical output stop; the separately valved flare branch remains available.
experiments.limitation: The response proves editable command, measurement and connection plumbing; it is not a validated control or operating procedure.

experiments.title: Lose the plant PLC
experiments.expected: Field I/O loses upstream communication and all three commanded valves stop transferring. Local pump and generator enable settings remain unchanged.
experiments.limitation: The response proves editable command, measurement and connection plumbing; it is not a validated control or operating procedure.

experiments.title: Close the digestate outlet
experiments.expected: Digestate discharge stops while digester stock and pressure indices respond to the changed branch acceptance.
experiments.limitation: The response proves editable command, measurement and connection plumbing; it is not a validated control or operating procedure.
